video_title: Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs react to NBA Finals Game 3 win vs. Knicks | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the intensity of playing in Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: At home it really feels like playing six against five. In here it feels like playing five against six.
quotes.quote: At home it really feels like playing six against five. In here it feels like playing five against six, and I agree with Luka. It really shows what teams are made of.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his complete trust in Jeremy Sochan
quotes.excerpt: The trust is not even a question. That's his identity. The trust is just complete.
quotes.quote: The trust is not even a question. That's his identity. The trust is just complete. We know it's as reliable as they get and experienced at that, so he brings everything we need.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the importance of aggressive play in difficult situations
quotes.excerpt: Difficult situations make us bring out the urgency in the execution.
quotes.quote: Difficult situations make us bring out the urgency in the execution. We know we won't have a hundred chances.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Les situations difficiles font ressortir l'urgence dans l'exécution. On sait qu'on n'aura pas cent chances.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the mental toll of the NBA playoffs
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to put your head out of the water.
quotes.quote: It's hard to put your head out of the water, and sometimes I don't even have to watch the game back right away. I just need a little time off, let my brain cool down, and recover as much for the body as for the mind.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the physical demands of the NBA playoffs
quotes.excerpt: The physical aspect is really the difference maker.
quotes.quote: I remember running laps and laps during the summer and my hamstrings were burning, but I was pushing through because that was what I was trying to push my limits. In the playoffs, I felt my hamstrings burning from running so much, playing sometimes 25 game minutes in a row. So the physical aspect is really the difference maker.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the maturity of Steph Castle
quotes.excerpt: He might be the most mature player on our team and he's nowhere near the oldest.
quotes.quote: He might be the most mature player on our team and he's nowhere near the oldest. He's been in big games before. He's been in big games before the NBA. It's I'm not surprised by this and he's shown over and over again that he's capable and that we are right to put our trust in him.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the key to closing out possessions
quotes.excerpt: Finishing our possessions late with a rebound defensively, I feel like those are what hurt the most.
quotes.quote: Finishing our possessions late with a rebound defensively, I feel like those are what hurt the most, and I think we did a good job closing out possessions.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his mindset during late-clock situations
quotes.excerpt: I was honestly getting ready to go crash and try and rebound, but I was able to get space.
quotes.quote: I saw the clock the whole time. I was honestly getting ready to go crash and try and rebound, but I was able to get space to get one off.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the impact of De'Aaron Fox's playmaking
quotes.excerpt: Having the ball in his hands late is a comfort thing for us.
quotes.quote: Having the ball in his hands late is a comfort thing for us, and I feel like whether he's shooting the ball well or not, he generates a good shot for us pretty much every time.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on his maturity compared to Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I don't go to sleep at 9:00 p.m., so I'm probably a close second.
quotes.quote: I don't go to sleep at 9:00 p.m., so I'm probably a close second. I mean yeah, probably Victor would be number one.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the physical nature of the playoff series
quotes.excerpt: Playoffs have really been physical for us leading up to this moment.
quotes.quote: Playoffs have really been physical for us leading up to this moment, so I feel like our previous series kind of prepared us for the physicality that they bring.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the biggest challenge for Game 4
quotes.excerpt: Not getting bored with the things that work for us and sticking with the process.
quotes.quote: Probably just not getting bored with the things that work for us and sticking with the process, even though it might not work out all the time.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the Knicks' defensive adjustments
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't say they made too big of adjustments against us. I feel like that's just how they play.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say they made too big of adjustments against us. I feel like that's just how they play, honestly, watching them throughout the year, playing them early in the year, they always load the paint.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the team's confidence despite the series deficit
quotes.excerpt: Whether we won or lost this game, the series wouldn't have been over for us.
quotes.quote: Whether we won or lost this game, the series wouldn't have been over for us, so obviously it feels good to win, especially on the road after dropping two bad ones.

quotes.speaker: Jeremy Sochan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan on the importance of pressure free throws
quotes.excerpt: We work on pressure free throws, situations like that all the time when we're in the gym.
quotes.quote: We work on pressure free throws, situations like that all the time when we're in the gym. I mean obviously you can't replicate anything like that, but I think just our will and want to win, no matter who went up there and went to the line, I feel like we would have knocked them down.

quotes.speaker: Gregg Popovich
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregg Popovich on the team's cohesion and selfless play
quotes.excerpt: We have a bunch of good guys whose personalities don't clash, people who are selfless.
quotes.quote: We have a bunch of good guys whose personalities don't clash, people who are selfless and it's made us a good team. We knew that we had talent, and it was how well and how quickly could we gel together.

quotes.speaker: Gregg Popovich
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregg Popovich on responding to the Knicks' first-half run
quotes.excerpt: We responded well to their run. They had a big run in the first half.
quotes.quote: We responded well to their run. They had a big run in the first half, they get up at halftime, and we're thinking to ourselves, how can we get back to playing the way that we're playing with the ball moving, with getting stops, not giving up offensive rebounds, not turning the ball over.

quotes.speaker: Gregg Popovich
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregg Popovich on the nature of high-stakes basketball
quotes.excerpt: It's a make-or-miss league a lot of times. It's get to your spot and if you miss, it is what it is.
quotes.quote: It's a make-or-miss league a lot of times. It's get to your spot and if you miss, it is what it is. You try to make that shot more often than not obviously, but it feels good to hit a big shot down the stretch.

quotes.speaker: Gregg Popovich
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregg Popovich on the team's defensive rotation strategy
quotes.excerpt: They want to get Victor out of the paint. We've gotten good about rotating around him.
quotes.quote: They want to get Victor out of the paint. We've gotten good about rotating around him, and he's gotten better at closing out to shooters, getting guys off the line while trying to stay in front of them. With someone like Landry who obviously shoots the skin off the ball, he got them off the line, we're scrambling around him, does he want to finish over him or not? He elected to try to finish over him, he blocked the shot.

quotes.speaker: Gregg Popovich
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregg Popovich on maintaining composure during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: You continue to play the right way. That's all there is.
quotes.quote: You continue to play the right way. That's all there is. Make or miss, I'm not just going to be forcing shots because I'm hot or because I'm missing shots. We always talk about it, when we're moving the ball, regardless of who it is, the ball finds who it needs to find.
